question: Can three independently fitted projection edits repair misleading camera, laptop and watch labels while preserving object recognition, legitimate controlled text reading, unrelated edit words and sequential parameter states?

protected.objective: equal mean of target distractor, clean object and legitimate text accuracy across all edit words
protected.tie_break: fewest newly introduced clean errors, then declared index

finetune.objective: equal mean of target distractor, clean object and legitimate text accuracy across all edit words
finetune.tie_break: fewest newly introduced clean errors, then declared index

finite_stop: 9 independent edits, 6 x 25 FT updates, and all 18 sequential edits completed
limitations: Controlled typographic object-recognition benchmark, not arbitrary visual knowledge editing
Source photographs held out by exact content and identifier; physical object and near-duplicate grouping not independently audited
Controlled legitimate text cards are a task-preservation stress test, not natural-scene OCR
Prior v1 support and retention data reused only for fitting, never for v2 validation or final scoring
